```artifact
<Test Suite in Sequence Diagrams Notation>

Diagram 1: Doctor Views Appointments
Participants: Doctor, AppointmentSystem
1. Doctor -> AppointmentSystem: RequestAppointments
2. AppointmentSystem -> Doctor: AppointmentsList

Diagram 2: Doctor Provides Consultation
Participants: Doctor, Patient, ConsultationSystem
1. Doctor -> Patient: RequestConsultation
2. Patient -> Doctor: Confirm
3. Doctor -> ConsultationSystem: ProvideConsultation
4. ConsultationSystem -> Doctor: GeneratePrescription
5. Doctor -> Patient: PrescriptionDetails

Diagram 3: Doctor Prescribes Lab Tests
Participants: Doctor, Patient, LabSystem
1. Doctor -> Patient: RequestLabTest
2. Patient -> Doctor: Confirm
3. Doctor -> LabSystem: TestRequest
4. LabSystem -> Doctor: TestScheduled

Diagram 4: Lab Test Request
Participants: LabSystem, Lab
1. LabSystem -> Doctor: TestScheduledConfirmation
2. Doctor -> Lab: Confirm

Diagram 5: Lab Test Performed and Report Generated
Participants: Lab, LabSystem, Doctor
1. Lab -> LabSystem: PerformTest
2. LabSystem -> Doctor: TestReport
2. Doctor -> LabSystem: ReportReceived

Diagram 6: Doctor Receives Lab Report
Participants: Doctor, LabSystem
1. Doctor -> LabSystem: ReportReceived
2. LabSystem -> Doctor: TestReport

```

```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Doctor Views Appointments",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-5-9"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Doctor is logged in"],
    "inputs": {"name": "RequestAppointments"},
    "steps": [
      "Doctor sends RequestAppointments to AppointmentSystem",
      "Doctor receives AppointmentsList from AppointmentSystem"
    ],
    "expected": ["Doctor successfully views the appointments/consultation request pending"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-0zym",
    "title": "Doctor Provides Consultation",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-5-10"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Doctor has a consultation with Patient"],
    "inputs": {"name": "ProvideConsultation"},
    "steps": [
      "Doctor provides consultation to Patient",
      "Doctor sends PrescriptionDetails to Patient"
    ],
    "expected": ["Consultation is provided and prescription is generated"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Doctor Prescribes Lab Tests",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-5-11"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Doctor has discussed lab tests with Patient"],
    "inputs": {"name": "RequestLabTest"},
    "steps": [
      "Doctor sends RequestLabTest to Patient",
      "Patient confirms",
      "Doctor sends TestRequest to LabSystem",
      "Doctor receives TestScheduledConfirmation from LabSystem"
    ],
    "expected": ["Lab Test for the patient is created and lab is requested to perform the lab test"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Lab Test Request",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-5-12"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["LabTestRequest confirmed"],
    "inputs": {"name": "TestRequest"},
    "steps": [
      "LabSystem performs the test",
      "LabSystem sends TestScheduledConfirmation to Doctor"
    ],
    "expected": ["Lab test is requested and scheduled"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Lab Test Performed and Report Generated",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-5-15"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Lab test is scheduled"],
    "inputs": {"name": "PerformTest"},
    "steps": [
      "Lab performs the test",
      "Lab sends TestReport to LabSystem",
      "LabSystem sends TestReport to Doctor"
    ],
    "expected": ["Lab tests are performed and reports for corresponding patient are updated (Offline)"],
    "negative_paths": [
      "Lab fails to perform test",
      "Lab does not send TestReport to LabSystem"
    ],
    "boundary_values": {
      "test_duration": "shortest and longest expected test durations"
    }
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Doctor Receives Lab Report",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-5-16"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Lab report is generated"],
    "inputs": {"name": "ReportReceived"},
    "steps": [
      "Doctor receives ReportReceived from LabSystem",
      "Doctor views TestReport"
    ],
    "expected": ["Lab report for the patient is released to view"],
    "negative_paths": [
      "Doctor does not receive ReportReceived from LabSystem",
      "Doctor views nothing after receiving ReportReceived"
    ],
    "oracle_assertiveness": "Doctor should be able to view the lab report accurately and promptly",
    "groundedness": "Expected outcomes are derived from the requirement text"
  }
]
```

Note: The JSON test cases are simplified and assume synchronous communication for the sake of clarity. In a real-world scenario, you would need to account for asynchronous communication and potential network latency. Additionally, negative paths and boundary values should be expanded to fully test the system's robustness against errors and edge cases. The "shortest and longest expected test durations" in the boundary values section would need to be defined based on the actual system capabilities and expected performance metrics. The "oracle assertiveness" in the groundedness section should be further detailed with specific expected outcomes, including error messages or codes if the system behaves differently under failure conditions. The "preconditions" should also be more detailed, specifying the exact state required before each test case is executed.
